original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports stablecoin wallets are beginning to replace traditional bank accounts as the primary consumer payment hub. This is a structural market shift. When fiat liquidity lives natively on-chain rather than inside legacy banking rails, friction vanishes. Capital sits one hop away from spot $BTC order books, eliminating deposit delays when volatility returns. With $BTC compressing tightly near $78,600 in a 1.7% intraday range, expanding on-chain payment rails are quietly building liquidity depth underneath price. Bullish, bearish, or wait Is the market confirming this catalyst, or fading it?
